source.name: FIAWEC.com: Manthey targets title hat-trick with 'strong' 2026 driving crews
source.note: The front placement maps from the team title carried in the entry's full team name 'MANTHEY DK ENGINEERING' (fiawec.com car page for #91), as the WEC league notes provide. Manthey's own announcement of the line-up says the same: 'James Cottingham, Timur Boguslavskiy and Ayhancan Güven will be at the wheel of the 'Manthey DK Engineering' Porsche' (https://www.manthey-racing.com/manthey-unveils-strong-driver-line-2026-fia-world-endurance-championship-season, page without a date, first Wayback capture 15 January 2026).
source.quote: In the sister #91 'Manthey DK Engineering' car, James Cottingham, Timur Boguslavskiy and Ayhancan Güven provide a blend of experience and new blood.

summary: 2026 FIA WEC LMGT3 #91 'Manthey DK Engineering' Porsche 911 GT3 R (James Cottingham, Timur Boguslavskiy, Ayhancan Güven), run by Manthey. DK Engineering, a British Ferrari specialist whose managing director drives the car, is the title partner, entered here as the front placement mapped from the team title. Only the title sponsor is recorded: car-livery placements do not fit the kit schema yet (WEC league notes), and the launch sources name no other partner on the #91 livery, so the sponsor list is not marked complete.
